UseActorArt.Name: Use Actor Art
UseActorArt.Hint: Show actor images instead of token images

GridSize.Name: Grid Size
GridSize.Hint: Size in pixels of each token portrait in the grid

GridColumns.Name: Grid Columns

Open.Hint: Open the token stack picker window at the current mouse position. Hold Shift to target every token in the stack or Alt to clear all targets
